propos: Every component delivered so far, in all its variants and states.
etats-communs: Common states: rest · pressed (raised block background) · focus (3 px accent ring, 2 px from the edge) · disabled (secondary text, never transparency) · loading (spinning arc, or skeleton).
interactif: Pressed and focus cannot be frozen on a board: press a control to see the first, tab through the section to see the second.
absents-propos: The mock-up also draws an activity row, a message bubble, a source quotation, a notification card and the role badge set on the avatar. None of them ships yet: they arrive with the screen that uses them. Drawing them by hand would make the board lie, and a board that lies is worse than none.
